name: Monaco Editor Plugin
description: Monaco code editor with multi-tab editing. Dynamically loads Monaco via AMD require() at runtime (bootstrap once, shared across all instances). Custom dark/light themes (cockpit-dark, cockpit-light). 24 language types detected from file extension. Per-tab cursor position, column, and scrollTop tracking. Ctrl+S save action. 1.5s debounced auto-save on content change. External file change detection via fs:onChanged with auto-reload (preserves cursor if content matches). Full tab state serialization/restoration. Open/close/switch tabs with close button per tab. Undo/redo support.

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Read file via IPC, create or switch to tab, load into editor

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Serialize current tab state for persistence

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restore tabs and cursor positions from saved state

methods.name: updateTheme
methods.description: Update Monaco theme to match current dark/light mode

properties.name: tabs
properties.description: Open tab list with filePath, name, originalPath

features.multi_tab: Multiple files open simultaneously with tab bar and close buttons
features.auto_save: 1.5s debounced auto-save to disk via IPC on content change
features.external_change_detection: fs:onChanged listener — reloads file in editor if it matches an open tab
features.custom_themes: cockpit-dark and cockpit-light Monaco themes matching CSS palette
features.state_persistence: Full serialization: openFiles[], activeFile, cursors{filePath: {lineNumber, column, scrollTop}}
